newsitem.title: USA: Massbank Corp sets four-for-three split.
newsitem.headline: Massbank Corp sets four-for-three split.

text.p: Massbank Corp said on Thursday that its directors had approved a four-for-three stock split of the company's common stock, to take the form of a stock dividend.
The stock dividend will be payable on September 15 to stockholders of record on August 29, Massbank said in a statement.
In addition, the holding company declared a dividend of $0.32 per share, up $0.05 per share from the dividend paid in the previous quarter.
The increase will raise the annualized dividend from $1.08 to $1.28 per share, the company said. The dividend will be payable on August 13 to stockholders of record on July 30.

Finally, Massbank Corp said its directors had extended for a year the stock repurchase program which it authorized in July of 1996 and increased by 25,000 the number of shares of the company's common stock authorized for repurchase in the current program.
The increase brings the total shares available for repurchase to 148,654 during the next twelve months.
The company said it may use the repurchased shares to fund employee benefit programs.
